source.algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted runtime paths and bytes

environment.scope: Local deterministic common simulator; no hosted capacity/FPS claim

methodology.positions: Seeded createArena initial layout; compatibility816 only uses legacy fixed XY
methodology.swapped: Both build-array sides for every seed
methodology.synthetic: Basic T5 and element override counterfactual cases explicitly flagged; excluded from legal T5 profile rates
methodology.pressure: Unchanged production policy; endings and pressure damage counted separately
methodology.awakening: Damage and healing are actual awakening-marked amounts, not counterfactual incremental benefit. awakeningBlockedA sums actual positive block events within ordered awakening-start/end windows, including ordinary defense during that window; it is not incremental awakening defense. Damage-free spatial utility is covered by effect tests, not falsely counted as a damaging hit.
methodology.wilson: 95% Wilson binary win rate; draws are separately reported, not treated as wins
